summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend regression for the new EOI -> NDA -> Full Details public flow. 29/29 backend pytest passing. All 4 frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: 3-step state machine, EOI decline terminal screen, Settings NDA Templates tab (built-in prefill + default pill + save), ProjectDetail Disciplines tab (skip-NDA/anonymise toggles + replacement banner with discipline pre-fill).
verified_flows: GET /api/public/invites/{token}/eoi marks invite viewed and returns project summary, anonymise honoured
GET /details returns 403 before NDA, 200 after sign or skip_nda=true
GET /nda/pdf returns 404 before signing, application/pdf >1KB starting with %PDF after signing
POST /nda/sign 400 if agree=false, 200 success, status -> nda_signed, already_signed flag flips true
GET /library/nda/builtin returns ~2.4KB built-in NDA, 401 without auth
POST /library type=nda_template is_default=true updates settings.default_nda_id and overrides built-in for sub-consultant fetch
PATCH anonymise_client=true replaces real client_name with 'Confidential client' on EOI and rendered NDA
POST /interest interested=false sets status=declined, decline_stage=eoi, decline_reason captured
POST /respond status=declined after NDA-signed sets decline_stage=details
Frontend RespondPage: EOI step -> click 'I'm interested' -> NDA step -> sign-button disabled until agree -> sign -> Details step -> submit -> 'Response Recorded' toast
Frontend RespondPage: EOI -> Decline -> reason -> DeclinedView terminal screen 'Invitation declined'
Frontend Settings -> NDA Templates: 'Use built-in' prefills 2459-char NDA, save shows item with 'Default' pill
Frontend ProjectDetail -> Disciplines: replacement banner shows declined discipline (MEP), 'Invite replacement' pre-fills MEP in form
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1240 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting public flow + library + invites into routers/modules.
DEFAULT_NDA_TEMPLATE is governed by Disclosing Party's jurisdiction with no jurisdiction value - acceptable for MVP but flag for legal review before production.
_notify_owner uses asyncio.create_task without keeping references; tasks may be GC'd. Acceptable for fire-and-forget but consider a task set.
PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var is NOT set in /app/backend/.env so SMTP notification share_url and 'Open project' link in owner emails will be relative paths only.

/app/backend/tests/test_rfp_backend.py is now stale: test_public_get_invite_no_auth and test_public_respond_no_auth call the OLD pre-flow endpoints and will fail (the old GET /api/public/invites/{token} no longer exists; respond now requires NDA). Replace with test_eoi_nda_flow.py going forward.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated FastAPI - replace with lifespan context manager.
JWT_SECRET in .env is the literal placeholder 'change-me-in-production-rfp-analyser-secret-key'.
test_credentials: demo@rfpqa.example.com / DemoPass123! (existing seeded). New tests create eoiowner_<rand>@rfpqa.example.com.
seed_data_creation: Tests create one project + 6 invites + 1 NDA template per run. Cleanup test deletes the template and project (cascade-deletes invites). Manual UI test data was deleted post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_eoi_nda_flow.py as the regression suite for the EOI/NDA/details flow - it does NOT call /analyze (LLM exhausted). The older /app/backend/tests/test_rfp_backend.py has 2 stale tests against deleted endpoints and triggers /analyze - either skip or rewrite if regression on legacy paths is needed. PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unset; SMTP notifications use relative URLs. demo@rfpqa.example.com login still works.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Previous session's blockers (missing Request import, broken _ensure_full_access dead code) are confirmed fixed - public/{token}/nda/sign captures request.client.host correctly and _require_full_access cleanly returns on skip_nda or nda_signed_at.
